This is a document that lets me sit and explor the results using the new dip test, before I write specific constraints.

```{r}
#| label: load-stuff
tar_load(c(not_gray_pca, sets_confounding_factors))
tar_source("R")
```


```{r}
#| label: combined-p-value
library(poolr)

do_fishers_justp = function(p_vals) {
  out_res = poolr::fisher(p_vals)
  out_res$p
}

null_sets = purrr::map_lgl(sets_confounding_factors, is.null)
keep_sets = sets_confounding_factors[!null_sets]
keep_sets_combined = purrr::map(keep_sets, \(in_factor){
  # in_factor = keep_sets[[1]]
  # in_factor = keep_sets[[162]]
  # in_factor = keep_sets[[415]]
  # in_factor = keep_sets[[1725]]
  
  if (all(is.na(in_factor$anova$p.value)) || nrow(in_factor$dip) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (nrow(in_factor$dip) == 1) {
    summarized_dip = tibble::tibble(PC = in_factor$dip$PC, pvalpooled = in_factor$dip$p.value)
  } else {
    summarized_dip = in_factor$dip |>
      dplyr::summarise(pvalpooled = do_fishers_justp(padjust), .by = PC)
  }
  
  in_factor$summarized_dip = summarized_dip
  in_factor
})

null_sets2 = purrr::map_lgl(keep_sets_combined, is.null)
keep_sets_combined2 = keep_sets_combined[!null_sets2]
```

```{r}
#| label: range-of-dip
dip_stats = purrr::map(keep_sets_combined2, \(in_set){
  in_set$summarized_dip |>
    dplyr::mutate(internal_id = in_set$analysis_id)
}) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

dip_pc1 = dip_stats |>
  dplyr::filter(PC %in% "PC1")
```

```{r}
#| label: check-colors
not_gray_pca_confound = dplyr::left_join(not_gray_pca, dip_pc1, by = "internal_id")

not_gray_pca_confound |>
  ggplot(aes(x = -1 * log10(pvalpooled))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  facet_wrap(~ overall_status, ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_log10()

not_gray_pca_confound |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_g05 = sum(pvalpooled <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), .by = overall_status)
```

```{r}
#| label: sex-confounding
has_confounding = dip_pc1 |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvalpooled) & (pvalpooled <= 0.05))

keep_sets_combined2_id = purrr::map_chr(keep_sets_combined2, \(x){x$analysis_id})
has_confounding_sets = keep_sets_combined2[keep_sets_combined2_id %in% has_confounding$internal_id]

has_male_female = purrr::map_lgl(has_confounding_sets, \(in_set){
  all(c("male", "female") %in% in_set$factor_types$factor) || all(c("m", "f") %in% in_set$factor_types$factor)
})
```
